summary: First-finish smoke test of Momentum productivity app. Backend endpoints (auth register/login/me, tasks CRUD, goals, notes, AI breakdown, chat SSE, chat history) all return 200 with correct payloads. UI flows verified end-to-end: landing CTAs render, registration lands on /app/dashboard, all 4 stat cards visible, task creation via Tasks page works with toast confirmation, logout returns to /login, and re-login lands on dashboard. AI breakdown transiently failed once with a 'Budget has been exceeded' error from litellm but succeeded on immediate retry, producing 5+ well-formed tasks tied to the goal. Chat streaming (SSE) returned Claude-generated content that referenced the user's actual goal/tasks, confirming context injection.
passed: POST /api/chat/stream -> SSE streams Claude tokens with 'event: done' terminator; response references user's goal/task (context injection working)
POST /api/ai/breakdown-goal -> 200 on retry, generates 5+ tasks with proper schema (title/description/priority/estimated_minutes) linked to goal_id
Landing page: landing-login, landing-signup, hero-start-button all present
Register flow via UI -> redirects to /app/dashboard, dashboard-page visible
Dashboard shows stat-active-goals, stat-open-tasks, stat-completion-rate, stat-notes-count
Task creation from Tasks page (new-task-button -> task-title-input -> submit) shows 'Task added' toast and appears in list
Logout button clears session and redirects to /login
Re-login with same credentials lands on dashboard

failed.issue: First call returned HTTP 500 with 'AI error: Failed to start streaming completion: litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0'. Immediate retry with a new goal succeeded. Appears to be a transient upstream/litellm proxy issue rather than a code defect (chat endpoint using same key/model succeeded in the same window).
failed.evidence: curl POST /api/ai/breakdown-goal -> HTTP 500 on first attempt, then HTTP 200 with valid tasks JSON on retry seconds later. Model used: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 in server.py L433 & L539.

action_items: Optional: add a single-retry-on-transient-error wrapper around LlmChat.stream_message in /api/ai/breakdown-goal (server.py L437) so users don't see the intermittent 'Budget has been exceeded' 500 on first click.
Verify the model identifier 'claude-sonnet-4-6' at server.py:433,539 is the intended one (spec called for Claude Sonnet 4.5). It works via the Emergent proxy but the naming may be off.
